selected_work: R87 broaden deterministic hosted semantic coverage for the already-supported F20 fixed-function subset.
summary: Extended the existing R86 fixed-function HLSL semantic smoke without changing production renderer/runtime/shader-generator code. Added zero-active-stage diffuse passthrough; a three-stage chain reaching stage 2 with SELECTARG2, TEXCOORD5, linear filtering and clamp addressing; plus explicit fail-closed reason checks for a disabled-stage hole, D3DTA_COMPLEMENT, D3DTTFF_COUNT2 and D3DTEXF_ANISOTROPIC. Supported cases must generate HLSL and pass the existing non-routing D3DCompile ps_4_0 probe.

activation_gate.reason: R87 only strengthens offline deterministic semantic/compiler evidence. It does not execute shaders on a D3D11 device, bind native shaders, prove live resource mirrors, translate F21 programmable shaders or establish exact-build Quest3/VDXR parity.

next_action: Keep NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed=false and shaderTranslationExact=false. Hosted semantic coverage for the current F20 subset is stronger, but runtime census/GPU evidence is still absent. The next runtime-independent bounded DX11 task should address another open activation prerequisite, preferably an F19 input-layout edge such as currently fail-closed FVF blend-weight/index encodings, while keeping F21 programmable shader translation separate.
